summary.zh: 用户评价对机械手感较积极，但蓝牙同步体验存在分歧。
summary.en: Owner reports praise the mechanical feel but differ on Bluetooth synchronization.

tradeoffs.zh: 官网显示缺货；$39.99 是留存页面标价，不保证可购买。
tradeoffs.en: The official store shows sold out; $39.99 is a displayed price, not guaranteed availability.

note.zh: 2019-07-07 众筹支持者已收到实物并发表体验；2018 众筹不等于交付。
note.en: A backer reported receiving and testing the product on 7 July 2019; 2018 crowdfunding is not delivery.

note.zh: 查阅时页面标价；以具体版本与结算页为准。
note.en: Displayed page price at consultation; version and checkout may differ.

highlights.zh: 转动和空间方向追踪，结合灯光与 App。
highlights.en: Turn and spatial-orientation tracking, lights and an app.

summary.zh: 当年的实物体验认为连接和动作映射出色；软件统计解读仍有改进空间。
summary.en: A contemporary hands-on report praised connectivity and motion mapping while questioning parts of the software analysis.

tradeoffs.zh: 圆鼓外形与传统三阶不同，价格为套装；不与裸魔方直接比价。
tradeoffs.en: The pillowed shape differs from a standard cube, and the quoted bundle is not a bare-cube price.

note.zh: Rubik's Brand Ltd 当日正式发布新品新闻稿，介绍红牛线上赛事用途。
note.en: Rubik's Brand Ltd issued its product announcement that day for the online Red Bull event.

note.zh: 查阅时页面标价；以具体版本与结算页为准。
note.en: Displayed page price at consultation; version and checkout may differ.

highlights.zh: 沿用 GoCube 平台，支持在线赛事连接。
highlights.en: Uses the GoCube platform for online competition.

summary.zh: 显示智能硬件从教学玩具向线上比赛工具扩展。
summary.en: Illustrates smart hardware expanding into online competition.

tradeoffs.zh: 平台赛事能力不等于 WCA 实体赛的器材许可。
tradeoffs.en: An online tournament feature is not a statement of WCA equipment eligibility.

name.zh: Rubik's Magnetic Speed Cube（2024 商家记录）

note.zh: 零售商标注的 Release Date 或上架日；全球官方首发待核。
note.en: Retailer Release Date or listing date; the official global launch remains unverified.

note.zh: 查阅时页面标价；以具体版本与结算页为准。
note.en: Displayed page price at consultation; version and checkout may differ.

adjustment.zh: 可调轴距与弹力；具体档位未核实。
adjustment.en: Adjustable tension and compression; exact settings unverified.

highlights.zh: 原品牌产品加入磁定位及双重调节。
highlights.en: The original brand incorporates magnetic alignment and two adjustments.

summary.zh: 证明磁定位已进入 Rubik's 品牌本身的速拧线。
summary.en: Documents magnetic alignment in Rubik's own speed-cube line.

tradeoffs.zh: 2024-08-27 仅是该商家记录，不能推出该年是 Rubik's 首次做磁力三阶。
tradeoffs.en: 27 August 2024 is this store's listing date, not proof of Rubik's first magnetic cube.

note.zh: 品牌 50 周年官方介绍项目及合作背景。
note.en: The brand's 50th-anniversary account documents the product and collaboration.

highlights.zh: 与美国盲人联合会合作，用不同触觉形状辨认六面。
highlights.en: Developed with the National Federation of the Blind, using distinct tactile shapes for faces.

summary.zh: 三阶的发展还包括无障碍设计，速拧速度不是唯一性能维度。
summary.en: Accessibility is another dimension of 3×3 development beyond speed.

tradeoffs.zh: 触觉识别产品不按普通速拧旗舰的评分方式比较。
tradeoffs.en: A tactile-learning design requires different evaluation criteria from a speed flagship.

name.zh: Type D 三阶（历史商品称谓）

note.zh: 当天买家记录收到从 Cube4You 购买的黑、白 Type D，证明此前已销售；不是官方首发日。
note.en: A buyer recorded receiving black and white Type D cubes from Cube4You that day, establishing prior commercial availability, not an official launch.

highlights.zh: 同期玩家把 Type D 块体与 Type A 轴心组合，体现早期混合改装文化。
highlights.en: Contemporary users combined Type D pieces with Type A cores, illustrating early hybrid modification.

summary.zh: 论坛记录可证实它作为独立商品销售；用户对换轴后的手感评价积极。
summary.en: The forum establishes a separately sold product; users described positive experiences after core swaps.

tradeoffs.zh: 评价主要针对改装组合；现有证据不足以确认所有 Type D 的制造商、标准尺寸或首发价。
tradeoffs.en: Most praise concerns modified hybrids; the evidence does not identify the manufacturer of every Type D, standard dimensions or launch price.

note.zh: 2010-05-20 买家已在意大利网店下单，06-04 记录收到；这是可证实的销售时间上限，不是官方首发日。
note.en: A buyer had ordered it from an Italian shop by 2010-05-20 and recorded receipt on 06-04; this establishes availability by that date, not the official launch.

note.zh: 2010-09-17 原创评测记录海燕网店售价 25 美元，含当时全球邮寄；不是现价。
note.en: The 2010-09-17 original review reports USD 25 at Haiyan’s shop including worldwide shipping at the time; not a current offer.

adjustment.zh: 打开中心盖后用螺丝调节松紧。
adjustment.en: Tension is adjusted by screws beneath removable center caps.

highlights.zh: 以 Alpha V / 国甲甲五为基础，由海燕打磨棱块内侧倒角、组装并润滑。
highlights.en: Based on Alpha V, with internal edge corners rounded through sanding, followed by assembly and lubrication by Haiyan.

summary.zh: 2010 年原创上手评测认为转动顺滑、容错优于作者的 Ghost Hand；属于单个非竞速专家的比较。
summary.en: A 2010 hands-on reviewer found smoother turning and better corner-cutting than his Ghost Hand; this was one non-expert speedsolver’s comparison.

tradeoffs.zh: 该评测未量测飞棱率；手工打磨与原厂独立模具应在历史分类中区分。
tradeoffs.en: The review did not measure pop frequency; hand-modified production should be distinguished from a wholly independent mold.

note.zh: 当天买家同时收到 Memory 和 Haiyan’s Cube，并明确两者内构不同；证明该型号此前已商业销售，不是官方首发日。
note.en: A buyer received both Memory and Haiyan’s Cube that day and explicitly distinguished their mechanisms, establishing prior commercial availability rather than an official launch.

note.zh: 缺货历史商品页展示价 10.50 美元，原划线价 13.65 美元；无原始快照日期，非现货报价。
note.en: An out-of-stock historical listing displays USD 10.50, reduced from USD 13.65; original snapshot date unknown, not a live-stock offer.

adjustment.zh: DIY 套件包含轴心、螺丝、弹簧和贴纸。
adjustment.en: The DIY kit includes a core, screws, springs and stickers.

highlights.zh: 与 Memory 分开销售；零售商名称为 Alpha (Type A) HaiYan。
highlights.en: Sold separately from Memory; the retailer names it Alpha (Type A) HaiYan.

summary.zh: 2010 年收货者形容其转动轻快、省力，与 Memory 手感和结构不同。
summary.en: The 2010 buyer described light, low-effort turning and a mechanism and feel distinct from Memory.

tradeoffs.zh: 同一买家认为较方正的块体可能更容易卡顿；规格页只给包装重量，因此净重留空。
tradeoffs.en: The same buyer thought squarer pieces could catch more easily; the listing provides only packaged weight, so net weight is omitted.

note.zh: V1–V4 同日商家建档；初期页面预计 3 月底至 4 月初出货，不能把建档日当实际全球开售日。
note.en: V1–V4 share this retailer listing date; early pages expected late-March/early-April shipping, so listing is not a verified worldwide on-sale date.

adjustment.en: Screw tension and spring/MagLev compression adjustment, depending on V1–V4 configuration.

highlights.zh: V1 为角棱磁力；V2 增加角底与棱脚磁力，V3 增加中心排斥磁力辅助归位。
highlights.en: V1 uses corner-edge magnets; V2 adds corner-base/edge magnets, and V3 adds center repulsion for alignment.

highlights.zh: V4 使用六磁环悬浮机构；V1–V4 是同代配置阶梯。
highlights.en: V4 uses a six-ring MagLev system; V1–V4 are configuration tiers within one generation.

summary.zh: 通过块脚与中心磁力探索不同于常见球轴的回正手感。
summary.en: Explores alignment through piece-foot and center magnets, distinct from conventional ball-core layouts.

tradeoffs.zh: 各版磁力系统不同；高配的多段磁力反馈未必适合偏好均匀轻转的玩家。
tradeoffs.en: Magnetic systems differ by tier; the more segmented feedback of higher versions may not suit those who prefer uniform, light turning.

adjustment.en: Retains tension and compression tuning; regular, Full-Magnetic and ZCube/SAOCube editions use different magnetic systems.

highlights.zh: 改良模具与磁座安装，商家描述声音和转动更柔和。
highlights.en: Revised molds and easier magnet-capsule installation; retailer describes quieter, more refined turning.

highlights.zh: 后续 Full-Magnetic 标注 118 磁；ZCube 和 SAOCube 提供 8/32 磁轴等独立配置。
highlights.en: Later Full-Magnetic is listed with 118 magnets; ZCube and SAOCube offer separate 8/32-core-magnet configurations.

summary.zh: 一套基础设计衍生出普通、磁悬浮、磁轴与联名改装方案。
summary.en: One base design develops into conventional, MagLev, magnetic-core and collaboration configurations.

tradeoffs.zh: 不同命名体系交叠，不能将旧 V3 的块脚磁力、118 磁全磁版与 32 磁轴联名当作同一规格。
tradeoffs.en: Naming systems overlap; original V3 piece-foot magnets, the 118-magnet Full-Magnetic and the 32-core-magnet collaboration are distinct specifications.

highlights.zh: 88 磁配置结合核心磁力、磁悬浮和 UV 表面。
highlights.en: An 88-magnet configuration combines core magnets, MagLev and a UV finish.

highlights.zh: VIN 首款三阶产品线中的旗舰，早于 Racer 与 Lite 在该店上架。
highlights.en: The flagship of VIN’s debut 3x3 line, listed by this retailer before Racer and Lite.

summary.zh: 店内用户反馈有好控、润滑后转动出色的评价，手感很受调校影响。
summary.en: Retailer user feedback includes good control and strong turning after lubrication; setup affects the feel substantially.

tradeoffs.zh: 多条用户反馈提到开箱干涩、中心或磁环损坏；这是样本体验，不能推算总体故障率。不同商家尺寸重量也有分歧。
tradeoffs.en: Several users report dry initial feel and center or magnetic-ring damage; these samples do not establish a failure rate. Retailer size and weight figures also disagree.

highlights.en: A 64-magnet configuration retains a magnetic core and UV finish with spring centers.

highlights.en: Provides a distinct speed configuration between Lite and Nova.

summary.zh: 核心磁力与弹簧的组合提供不同于 Nova 磁悬浮版的调校路线。
summary.en: Core magnetism with springs provides a different tuning approach from the Nova’s MagLev system.

tradeoffs.zh: TheCubicle 上市页仍缺详细机构说明；不同商家净重、尺寸与档位组合说法并不一致。
tradeoffs.en: TheCubicle’s listing still lacks a full mechanism description; retailer weight, dimensions and setting counts disagree.

adjustment.en: Retailer lists CFRS tension/compression adjustment; the exact combination count remains to be confirmed.

highlights.en: Uses 48 piece magnets and a frosted finish, with a simpler configuration than the Nova.

highlights.zh: 以更低定价提供同产品线的基础转动与调节框架。
highlights.en: Provides the line’s basic turning and adjustment framework at a lower price.

summary.zh: 适合比较磁轴升级价值的标准版参照。
summary.en: A standard-version reference for assessing the value of magnetic-core upgrades.

tradeoffs.en: Initial feel receives mixed comments; this foot-magnet design cannot be ranked by ball-core magnet counts.

adjustment.zh: 8 档轴距 × 8 档弹力，共 64 组机械设置；磁力配置随版本变化。
adjustment.en: Eight tension × eight elasticity levels give 64 mechanical settings; magnetic configurations vary by version.

highlights.zh: 重新设计核心磁力布局；至尊版资料给出 20 核心磁铁与 6 磁环、总计 94 磁。
highlights.en: Redesigned core magnet layout; Ultimate is specified with 20 core magnets and six rings, totaling 94 magnets.

highlights.zh: 保留心形储油纹路和 56 mm 机身，推出四个配置档。
highlights.en: Retains heart-patterned lubricant surfaces and a 56 mm body across four configuration tiers.

summary.zh: 以数字化双调和更多核心磁力布局延续海豚系列。
summary.en: Continues the HaiTun line with numbered dual adjustment and expanded core magnetic layouts.

tradeoffs.zh: 零售商对标准、旗舰、先锋版的磁铁总数和核心数有矛盾，本条不替这些版本断言统一数量；弹力机构仍按商家列为弹簧。
tradeoffs.en: Retailer magnet totals and core counts conflict for Standard, Flagship and Pioneer, so no common count is asserted for them; elasticity is still listed as spring-based.

coverageNotes: 重点补充 1977/1980 起源、2008–2013 DIY 世代、方是与旋风小子、早期智能三阶；原型在发展节点叙述。
1980–2000 年代不同地区原版批次、国甲全部模具、国丙全部小尺寸、海燕/国恩/Ghost Hand、QJ/蓝蓝/乐方等仍未完整覆盖。
只把一般三阶和尺寸变体纳入型号；联名印刷、透明/限定色通常归入版本。异常形变、齿轮、镜面异形不在本表核心范围。

短补查仅新增三个有商业记录的条目；Type D 保留历史交易称谓，未将其全部归为永骏。 This short supplement adds only three commercially documented entries; Type D remains a historical trade designation and is not universally attributed to YJ.

海燕 Memory 是甲五手工打磨商品，Haiyan’s Cube 是同期单独销售的另一结构；应避免和现有 Alpha V 数据重复统计纯颜色 SKU。 Memory is a commercially sold hand-modified Alpha V; Haiyan’s Cube is a separate contemporary mechanism. Avoid counting color SKUs as additional models.
未找到足够可核实资料确认 Memory II 或海燕 Mini 独立商业型号，因此未添加。 Insufficient verifiable evidence was found for separate Memory II or Haiyan Mini commercial models, so they were not added.
所有日级日期均为同期商业流通证据，而非厂商首发公告；具体性质在 release.note 中注明。 All day-level dates establish contemporary commercial availability rather than manufacturer launch announcements, as stated in release.note.

补充 8 个商业型号，覆盖 MoreTry 梦图、VIN、HaiTun 海豚；按机械世代合并统计时，VIN3 三配置和斩浪 V1 双配置可进一步合并。 / Eight commercial models cover MoreTry, VIN and HaiTun; a strict mechanical-generation count may further combine the three VIN3 tiers and two Waverider V1 tiers.

天马 X3 的 V1/V2/V3/V4 为同代配置，不是连续四代；X3+ 的普通、全磁、ZCube、SAOCube 及 UV 外观版都放在变体中。 / Tianma X3 V1/V2/V3/V4 are same-generation configurations; X3+ regular, Full-Magnetic, ZCube, SAOCube and UV editions are grouped as variants.
所有日期均为零售商记录，未发现足够可靠的官方首发和中国官方首发价。 / All dates are retailer records; reliable official launch dates and Chinese official launch prices were not established.
价格采样截止 2026-10-07；停产留档价标 historical，不声称当年首发价或仍有现货。 / Prices were sampled through October 7, 2026; discontinued listing prices are historical, not asserted original MSRP or confirmation of stock.
VIN3 的净重和边长在商家间存在冲突，已并列注明；没有把包装毛重写成产品重量。 / Retailers disagree on VIN3 net weight and dimensions; the differences are stated, and packaged gross weight is excluded.

海豚斩浪 V2 零售资料把不同版本的磁铁总数/核心磁数交叉套用，本补充只在证据一致的至尊版标记 94 磁，对其余版本不伪造统一磁数。 / Waverider V2 retail descriptions mix magnet totals and core counts across versions; this supplement states 94 magnets only for the consistently documented Ultimate and avoids invented uniform counts.

海豚 V2 的核心磁环宣传不等于用磁悬浮取代中心弹簧；商家规格仍说明弹簧压缩，本条 mechanism 不标 MagLev。 / Waverider V2 core-ring marketing does not establish replacement of center springs with MagLev; retailer specifications retain spring compression, so MagLev is not tagged.

评测型评价为公开购买者的一手体验概括，样本不能推出总体故障率；编辑评价不冒充实测。 / Review assessments summarize firsthand purchaser experiences, which do not establish population failure rates; editorial judgments are not presented as measurements.
